title: Sarwar ke dil se
body:
sarwar ke dil se poochiye ulfat sakina ki
aati hai karbala se kyun nighat sakina ki
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein shaahe zaman jab huwe shaheed
ashoor ko ulat gayi kismat sakina ki
sarwar ke dil se poochiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
baade hussain chain se soyi na phir kabhi
seene pe sone ki thi jo aadat sakina ki
sarwar ke dil se poochiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam karun hussain aansu bahaun mai
dil mein hi ghut ke reh gayi hasrat sakina ki
sarwar ke dil se poochiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaaye tamache gaalon pe tha ek yehi sabab
tabdeel hoti rehti thi rangat sakina ki
sarwar ke dil se poochiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
farmeina binte shaah sun ay yazeed sun
badkaar tu kya samjhega raf'at sakina ki
sarwar ke dil se poochiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti ke ek ishaare pe aaya sar e hussain
sakte mein sab thi dekhi jo khudrat sakina ki
sarwar ke dil se poochiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan mein qaid hogayi maa aur phupi ke saath
sab ko wahan rulaati thi riqqat sakina ki
sarwar ke dil se poochiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon se bhara jo kurta tha wohi kafan bani
abid ne khud banayi hai turbat sakina ki
sarwar ke dil se poochiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli sakina baba ke sar se ye qaid mein
lene khabar ab aaye hai hazrat sakina ki
sarwar ke dil se poochiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
farshe aza pe ashk bahaate raho aijaz
aqif ki aarzoo hai to sunnat sakina ki
sarwar ke dil se poochiye...
author: Aijaz Rizvi
